shipping.title: Shipping & Delivery Policy
shipping.summary: Free delivery across India on all orders. Standard delivery takes 3 to 7 business days depending on location.
shipping.international: We currently do not offer international shipping (India only). For special requests, please contact our team on WhatsApp.
shipping.charges: Zero shipping fee (Free delivery across India on all orders).

exchange.title: Exchange Policy
exchange.summary: Size exchanges are accepted within 7 days of delivery, subject to product availability and a small reverse logistics handling fee. The item must be unworn, unwashed, and in its original packaging with tags intact.
exchange.process: To initiate a size exchange within 7 days, reach out to our support team on WhatsApp (+91 63679 70069) with your order number.

return_and_refund.title: Returns & Refund Policy
return_and_refund.summary: We do not offer cash refunds or returns for change of mind. All sales are final. We only replace or assist if you received a wrong or damaged item.
return_and_refund.damaged_or_wrong_item: If you received a defective, damaged, or incorrect product, we sincerely apologise. Please share your order number and unboxing video/photos on WhatsApp (+91 63679 70069) within 48 hours so we can resolve it immediately.

restock.title: Restock Policy
restock.summary: Exclusive limited drops only. Once a piece or size sells out, it is gone forever. We do not restock sold-out items.

cancellation.title: Order Cancellation
cancellation.summary: Orders cannot be cancelled or edited once placed. Please contact our support team on WhatsApp immediately if urgent assistance is needed.

support.note: Our team is available on WhatsApp for any issues outside standard automated assistance.
